C: clear entering ADC mover_types_second_sprite_offset (CMP #2 BCS not taken), and the frame+offset sum is <= &5D, so C clear into ADC #8. The raise is sprites_y_offset (&D99B) + index <= &5D, reaching &D9F8: the table (max &17), the helicopter tables (max &EC) and the SKIP padding to &DA00 (zeros in the listing), all < &F8, so ADC #8 leaves C clear and V clear, and the ADC first+&1C,X sees C=0 as before; its V/N/Z are overwritten there. Y passed to mark_part2/ren_draw_sprite is the raise (TAY before the ADC). Part three: Y = (raise+8) mod 256 as before; N/Z from LDY match old TAY's; C/V differ (old 0/0, new whatever ren_draw_sprite left) but LDA mover_types_third_sprite,X then mark_part3's SEC/SBC overwrite C and V before anything reads them, and N/Z come from its PLA, identical. X = dm_type in both; stack unchanged. Two-part movers: dm_raise now holds raise+8, never read. Cost note: the part-two path gains 2 cycles (ADC #8) for every two- or three-part mover; part three saves 6 (LDA zp 3, CLC 2, ADC 2, TAY 2 = 9 -> LDY zp 3), so net -4 per three-part mover and +2 per two-part mover; the claim's 4 x 1.1 counts only the saving and must be measured by the gate. Bytes: 6 -> 4 at part_three, ADC #8 +2 moved STA same: net 2 saved.
